description: This source file contains functions for comparing and matching Git trees, including scoring differences, filling tree descriptions, and manipulating tree objects such as splicing and shifting subtrees. It appears to be part of a larger version control system implementation, likely Git, focusing on tree object operations.

methods.name: int score_missing(unsigned mode)
methods.description: Calculates a score penalty for missing directory or link entries based on their mode.

methods.name: int score_differs(unsigned mode1,unsigned mode2)
methods.description: Calculates a score penalty for entries that differ in mode.

methods.name: int score_matches(unsigned mode1,unsigned mode2)
methods.description: Returns a score indicating similarity when entries match, with higher scores for directories and links.

methods.name: void * fill_tree_desc_strict(struct repository * r,struct tree_desc * desc,const struct object_id * hash)
methods.description: Reads a tree object from the object database and initializes a tree descriptor, ensuring the object is of type OBJ_TREE.

methods.name: int base_name_entries_compare(const struct name_entry * a,const struct name_entry * b)
methods.description: Compares two tree entries based on their base name, size, and mode.

methods.name: int score_trees(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * hash1,const struct object_id * hash2)
methods.description: Inspects two trees and produces a score reflecting their similarity using entry comparison.

methods.name: void match_trees(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * hash1,const struct object_id * hash2,int * best_score,char ** best_match,const char * base,int recurse_limit)
methods.description: Recursively matches subtrees between two trees to find the best match based on their similarity scores.

methods.name: int splice_tree(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid1,const char * prefix,const struct object_id * oid2,struct object_id * result)
methods.description: Replaces a subdirectory within a tree with another tree object, effectively splicing trees based on a prefix.

methods.name: void shift_tree(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * hash1,const struct object_id * hash2,struct object_id * shifted,int depth_limit)
methods.description: Creates a shifted version of a tree by prefixing or unprefixing subtrees to match another tree.

methods.name: void shift_tree_by(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * hash1,const struct object_id * hash2,struct object_id * shifted,const char * shift_prefix)
methods.description: Adjusts a tree by shifting it up or down based on a specified prefix, to align with another tree.
